paragraph1: Around here, comfort is seasoned with culture. Our Creole comfort cuisine is rooted in tradition, inspired by culture, and built with bold flavor. Every dish is prepared with care, every cocktail is handcrafted, and every visit is an invitation to gather, connect, and stay a while.
paragraph2: From rich, soulful entrées to signature cocktails and live music in The Flavor Room, we serve more than a meal. Whether you are discovering us for the first time or coming back again, there is always a seat waiting for you. Come for the flavor. Stay for the experience.

pillars.title: Caribbean & Creole
pillars.body: Cooked from scratch. Gumbo, oxtail, rum-glazed salmon, curry roti, and Signature baked mac. No shortcuts.

pillars.title: Cocktail Culture
pillars.body: A full bar of house cocktails and top-shelf spirits. Happy Hour Monday to Friday, 4 to 6PM, half off the good stuff.

pillars.title: Live Music, Up Close
pillars.body: Our former private room is now The Flavor House's live-music home, an intimate space built for real sets and real connection. New look coming soon.
